_notes: Brand name: marketing:v17.quick.cta/ctaWhy used 韩橘 (a Chinese rendering of 한귤) while every other zh-Hans string, the logo and the English keep 'Hangyul'. Changed to Hangyul for one-term-per-concept; if 韩橘 is an official Chinese brand name the owner should say so and it should then be used everywhere.

표준입학허가서 is rendered 标准入学许可书 wherever the document is meant (privacy document list, agency visa text, university enrolment hint); the short status chips keep 入学许可书 as the English keeps 'Admission letter'. 录取通知书 (offer letter) was wrong for this document.

Lists inside Chinese prose used the middle dot (·) as a list separator (e.g. 文件访问·审核·导出记录). In running text this reads as a typo; replaced with 、/与. Short chips and group labels (釜山·庆南, 新增·已分配) keep the dot, which is normal UI shorthand.
common:states.unavailableTitle/unavailableText were still English; translated with the glossary wording (no 'error', no 'failed').

common:fit.q.level (KO 어떤 과정을 공부하고 싶으세요?) and common:fit.levelLabel (KO 취득 급수 = the test level attained) are faithful to the Korean source even though the English says 'level' in both; left as they are.
common:fit.reason.unverified/unverifiedIeqas keep 在咨询时 because the Korean source (상담에서 함께 확인해요) says it; the English dropped it. Not a promise of an outcome.

Document-noun: marketing and the student-facing common strings say 材料, the consoles mostly say 文件. Both are natural Chinese and a full unification would touch hundreds of lines; left as is except where one screen mixed them.

KEYS MISSING FROM THE zh-Hans BUNDLE (cur = null, 89 keys: the v12 privacy-contact/processor tables, v20 city bodies and lines, city names, media alts, v20 match lines): these render in English today, so they were translated here; apply-patch.mjs creates a missing translation when the English has the key (dry run: 134 applied, 0 refused). All city names are the standard Chinese renderings of the hanja (청주 清州, 구미 龟尾, 여수 丽水 …).
Verified: every patched value keeps exactly the English {{placeholder}} set.

marketing:v20.city.Ulsan.body.text:
蔚山是韩国平均收入最高的城市，原因一目了然：世界最大的造船厂、本身就占了一个区的汽车工厂，以及沿海的石化工业区。工科毕业生在这里很受欢迎。
按韩国的标准，蔚山是座小城市，距釜山半小时车程，可以出海观鲸，有绵长的海滩，太和江穿城而过。

忠清北道是韩国唯一不临海的道。清州是道的中心，也是主要的大学城，离世宗和大田都很近，可以共享它们的就业市场。
这里以丹阳的石灰岩风景闻名，学生生活比大都市更安静，也更省钱。

marketing:v20.city.Daegu.body.text:
大邱坐落在韩国东南部的盆地里，八月是全国最热的城市，一月则是最冷的城市之一。市中心紧凑、适合步行；悠久的纺织业传统已发展成时尚和医疗器械产业；生活成本明显低于首尔和釜山。
坐 KTX 到首尔约 1 小时 45 分钟，到釜山 50 分钟。

marketing:v20.city.Daejeon.body.text:
大田围绕大德研究开发特区发展起来，这里聚集了政府研究机构和企业研发中心，大学也深受其影响。如果你想学工科或自然科学，实验室就在这里。
大田几乎位于韩国正中央：坐 KTX 到首尔 1 小时，到釜山也是 1 小时。

marketing:v20.city.Gangwon.body.text:

这里的冬天是真正的冬天。从首尔坐 KTX 到江陵约 2 小时。

光州是生活成本较低的广域市之一，艺术氛围浓厚，坐 KTX 到首尔约 2 小时。

这是一个面积大、风貌多样的道，而且处处都比首都圈便宜。

marketing:v20.city.Jeju.body.text:

岛上的大学不多，规模也小。飞往首尔的航班每隔几分钟一班，航程 1 小时。
